def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib='''from collections import Counter

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def separator_rows(grid, bg=None):
    """Full-width one-color rows whose color differs from the background."""
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]

def separator_cols(grid, bg=None):
    """Full-height one-color columns whose color differs from the background."""
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]

def index_blocks(total, seps):
    """Contiguous runs of indices that are not in seps."""
    s = set(seps); res = []; cur = []
    for i in range(total):
        if i in s:
            if cur: res.append(cur); cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(i)
    if cur: res.append(cur)
    return res

def content_blocks(grid, bg=None):
    """(row_block, col_block) of the contiguous region holding non-background cells."""
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sr, sc = separator_rows(grid, bg), separator_cols(grid, bg)
    rb = [b for b in index_blocks(h, sr) if any(grid[i][j] != bg for i in b for j in range(w) if j not in sc)]
    cb = [b for b in index_blocks(w, sc) if any(grid[i][j] != bg for j in b for i in range(h) if i not in sr)]
    return rb[0], cb[0]

def tile_pattern_blocks(grid, bg=None):
    """Extract the content block and replicate it (tiling, cyclically) into every region bounded by separator rows/cols."""
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sr, sc = separator_rows(grid, bg), separator_cols(grid, bg)
    rws, cls = content_blocks(grid, bg)
    p = [[grid[i][j] for j in cls] for i in rws]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rbk in index_blocks(h, sr):
        for cbk in index_blocks(w, sc):
            for a, i in enumerate(rbk):
                for bb, j in enumerate(cbk):
                    out[i][j] = p[a % len(p)][bb % len(p[0])]
    return out
'''

''')
